name: totem-tool
description: TOTeM Tool: object-centric process mining desktop and web application (React/Vite frontend, Django backend, totem_lib analysis core, Electron packaging)

scripts.start-electron: cd electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm start
scripts.build-frontend: cd frontend && cross-env VITE_LOCAL_MODE=1 npm run build-no-typecheck
scripts.prebuild:electron: shx rm -rf electron/resources && shx mkdir -p electron/resources/frontend-build && shx mkdir -p electron/resources/backend
scripts.build-all: npm run build-backend && npm run build-frontend && npm run prebuild:electron && npm run copy:frontend && npm run copy:backend && npm run build-electron-win
scripts.build-all-mac: npm run build-backend && npm run build-frontend && npm run prebuild:electron && npm run copy:frontend && npm run copy:backend && npm run build-electron-mac
scripts.electron-dev: concurrently "cross-env LOCAL_MODE=1 npm run start-backend" "wait-on http-get://localhost:8000/api/health-check/ && cross-env VITE_LOCAL_MODE=1 npm run start-frontend" "wait-on http-get://localhost:3000 && npm run start-electron"
